'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**The [[United Nations]] estimates that more than 300,000 people have been killed since the start of the [[civil war]] in 2011, which is 1.5% of [[Syria]]'s pre-war population. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syria-civilian-death-toll-over-306000-since-2011-un-2022-06-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Two policemen and a [[Polio in Pakistan|polio]] [[polio vaccine|vaccinator]] are shot dead by gunmen on motorcycles in [[North Waziristan]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-health-pakistan-police-11ef090765ea3b60a4f808467c58c2ee (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2019–present Sri Lankan economic crisis]], [[2021–2022 global energy crisis]]
**[[Sri Lanka]]'s [[Ministry of Power and Renewable Energy#Ministers|power and energy minister]] [[Kanchana Wijesekera]] announces that [[Government of Sri Lanka|the government]] will lift restrictions on fuel imports in response to the country's [[energy crisis]], ending a [[Energy industry|fuel]] [[duopoly]] between the state-owned [[Ceylon Petroleum Corporation]] and the [[Government of India|Indian government]]-owned [[Lanka IOC]]. [https://www.ibtimes.com/cash-starved-sri-lanka-end-fuel-duopoly-ease-fuel-shortages-3554273 (''International Business Times'')]
**Sri Lanka suspends sales of fuel for non-essential vehicles. For the next two weeks, only buses, trains and vehicles used for medical services and transporting food will be allowed to refuel. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-61961821 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tuluá prison riot]]
**A fire occurs during a [[prison riot]] in [[Tuluá]], [[Colombia]], killing 51 inmates and injuring 24 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/forty-nine-dead-prison-riot-colombia-prisons-agency-says-2022-06-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[June 2022 Afghanistan earthquake]]
**The United States government provides [[US$]]55 million in immediate humanitarian funding following the devastating [[earthquake]] in southern Afghanistan that killed at least 1,000 people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-provide-nearly-55-mln-more-humanitarian-aid-afghanistan-blinken-2022-06-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Mumbai building collapse]]
**Nineteen people are killed when a [[building collapse]]s in [[Mumbai]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/mumbai-building-collapse-kills-least-11-with-more-feared-trapped-2022-06-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Japan heatwave]]
**[[Tokyo]] records the city's highest temperature since 1875 as a [[heat wave]] continues. Several people are hospitalized due to [[heatstroke]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/tokyo-june-heatwave-worst-1875-power-supply-strain-2774381 (CNA)]
*Four people are killed when a helicopter crashes into the [[Arabian Sea]] near India. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/four-dead-indian-oil-firm-helicopter-crash-arabian-sea-2022-06-28/ (Reuters)]
*Authorities in Argentina issue a [[blizzard]] warning for [[Neuquén Province]] as roads remain blocked by snow. [https://www.rionegro.com.ar/sociedad/rutas-cerradas-y-otros-tramos-para-transitar-con-extrema-precaucion-en-neuquen-2369570/ (Rio Negro)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Europe]]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports nearly 70 new cases of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.rki.de/DE/Content/InfAZ/A/Affenpocken/Ausbruch-2022-Situation-Deutschland.html (RKI Deustche)]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports more than ten new cases of monkeypox. [https://www.dgs.pt/em-destaque/365-casos-confirmados-de-infecao-humana-por-virus-monkeypox-em-portugal.aspx (DGS Portugues)]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] reports nearly 200 new cases of monkeypox. [https://www.sanidad.gob.es/profesionales/saludPublica/ccayes/alertasActual/alertaMonkeypox/docs/Informe_de_situacion_MPX_20220628.pdf (Sanidad GOB Espanol)]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports nearly 200 cases of monkeypox. [https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/monkeypox-outbreak-epidemiological-overview/monkeypox-outbreak-epidemiological-overview-28-june-2022 (GOV.UK)]
***[[France]] reports more than 100 new cases of monkeypox. [https://www.santepubliquefrance.fr/les-actualites/2022/cas-de-variole-du-singe-point-de-situation-au-28-juin-2022 (Sante Publique France)]
***[[Italy]] reports two new cases of monkeypox. [https://www.salute.gov.it/portale/malattieInfettive/dettaglioSchedeMalattieInfettive.jsp?lingua=italiano&id=254&area=Malattie%20infettive&menu=indiceAZ&tab=1 (Salute GOV Italy)]
***[[Romania]] reports three new cases of monkeypox. [https://www.stiripesurse.ro/three-new-cases-of-monkeypox-diagnosed-in-romania_2448385.html (Stiripe Surse Romania)]
***[[Switzerland]] reports four new cases of monkeypox. [https://www.bag.admin.ch/bag/en/home/krankheiten/ausbrueche-epidemien-pandemien/aktuelle-ausbrueche-epidemien/affenpocken.html#573159143 (Swiss Confederation Health)]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Asia]]
***[[Israel]] reports five new cases of monkeypox. [https://www.gov.il/he/Departments/Guides/disease-monkeypox (Gov Israel)]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***[[Nebraska]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://www.ksnblocal4.com/2022/06/27/first-case-monkeypox-identified-nebraska/ (KSNB-TV)]
***[[Ohio]] reports its second case of monkeypox. [https://www.10tv.com/article/news/local/man-diagnosed-with-monkeypox-columbus/530-8813d771-1423-417d-b23a-daa460d3ab33 (WBNS-TV)]
***The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention|CDC]] announces that they will activate an [[emergency operations center]] for monkeypox. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/06/28/health/cdc-eoc-monkeypox/index.html (CNN)]
***The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] announces that over 296,000 doses of the [[smallpox vaccine|monkeypox vaccine]] will be distributed to combat the spread of monkeypox, including 56,000 doses of the [[Smallpox vaccine#Jynneos|Jynneos]] [[vaccine]]. [https://www.businessinsider.nl/white-house-to-distribute-296000-monkeypox-vaccines-and-increase-testing-as-virus-spreads/ (''Business Insider'')] [https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/3540508-white-house-details-monkeypox-vaccination-strategy/ (''The Hill'')] 
***The total number of monkeypox cases in the [[United States]] reaches 300. [https://www.cdc.gov/poxvirus/monkeypox/response/2022/world-map.html (CDC.GOV)]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Canada]]
***[[Canada]] reports more than 40 new cases of monkeypox. [https://www.canada.ca/en/public-health/services/diseases/monkeypox.html#a1 (Government of Canada)]
**[[Peru]] reports two new cases of monkeypox. [https://larepublica.pe/sociedad/2022/06/28/viruela-del-mono-en-peru-minsa-confirma-dos-nuevos-casos-del-monkeypox-jorge-lopez/ (La Republica Peru)]
**[[South Africa]] reports its second case of monkeypox. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/south-africa-records-second-monkeypox-case-health-ministry-2022-06-28/ (Reuters)]
**[[Benin]] reports their first three cases of monkeypox. [http://outbreaknewstoday.com/africa-benin-reports-3-monkeypox-cases-16828/ (Outbreak News Today)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Delhi]]
****[[Delhi]] reports their first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant#Sublineages and BA.2 subvariant|Omicron BA.5 variant]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/delhi-news/first-cases-of-ba-5-detected-in-delhi-101656356206891.html (''Hindustan Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[2022 NATO Madrid summit]], [[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Turkey]], [[Finland]], and [[Sweden]] sign a joint memorandum on security, clearing the way for [[Finland–NATO relations#Application|Finland]] and [[Sweden–NATO relations#Accession bid|Sweden's NATO accession bids]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/finnish-president-niinisto-says-turkey-has-agreed-back-finnish-swedish-nato-2022-06-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**[[Iran]]ian nuclear talks are moved to [[Qatar]] in a new bid to revive the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]]. [https://www.politico.com/amp/news/2022/06/27/u-s-envoy-headed-to-qatar-to-revive-iran-nuclear-talks-00042553 (Politico)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Freedom of the press in India]]
**Police in [[India]] arrest Mohammed Zubair, co-founder of fact-checking website [[Alt News]] who has been a vocal critic of [[Prime Minister of India|Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]]'s [[government of India|government]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-61956108 (BBC News)]
*[[2022 Saanich shootout]]
**Six police officers are injured and two bank robbers killed in a [[shootout]] at a bank in [[Saanich, British Columbia|Saanich]], [[British Columbia]], Canada. Nearby homes and businesses are later [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] due to a potential [[explosive device]] in the area. [https://www.vicnews.com/news/breaking-police-responding-to-reports-of-saanich-bank-robbery/ (Victoria News)]
*[[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|Russian opposition politician]] [[Ilya Yashin]] is sentenced to two weeks in prison after being arrested yesterday for "disobeying police". [https://www.barrons.com/news/russia-jails-opposition-activist-yashin-for-15-days-01656423908 (''Barron's'')]
*Protesting against the [[Fourth Rutte cabinet|government]]'s [[nitrogen]] policy, a group of Dutch farmers gathered at [[Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality|Minister for Nature and Nitrogen Policy]] [[Christianne van der Wal]]'s home and [[riot]]ed, forcing some police officers on the scene to flee for their own safety. [https://www.dutchnews.nl/news/2022/06/police-officers-forced-to-flee-as-farmers-protests-intensify/ (Dutch News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Scottish independence]]
**[[Proposed second Scottish independence referendum]]
***[[Nicola Sturgeon]], [[Scotland]]'s [[First Minister of Scotland|First Minister]], announces during a parliamentary debate session that an independence [[referendum]] bill will be tabled in the [[Scottish Parliament]]. The bill sets the date for the break-up vote at October 19, 2023. Sturgeon will try to bypass Prime Minister [[Boris Johnson]]'s unlikely permission to conduct the referendum by referring the bill to the [[Supreme Court of the United Kingdom]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/06/28/scottish-government-seeks-independence-vote-in-october-2023.html (CNBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/jun/28/nicola-sturgeon-seeks-supreme-court-ruling-on-scottish-independence-referendum-vote (''The Guardian'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[Racism in sport]]
**In [[motorsport]], [[Red Bull GmbH|Red Bull]] terminates Estonian driver [[Jüri Vips]]'s contract with [[Red Bull Junior Team|its junior team]] following an incident where Vips was heard using the word "[[nigga]]" on a [[Twitch (service)|Twitch]] [[livestream]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/06/29/motorsport/juri-vips-red-bull-contract-terminated-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
